نسترئف (form X)
# نَسْتَرْئِفُ (nastarʔifu) /nas.tar.ʔi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# نَسْتَرْئِفَ (nastarʔifa) /nas.tar.ʔi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# نَسْتَرْئِفْ (nastarʔif) /nas.tar.ʔif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
